title: pick
description: One line of data/picks.jsonl (RFC-023, ADR-0023, RFC-032 step 6): an action on one item of one dataset, appended, never rewritten. The latest line for an item wins. `pick` marks a production item as a candidate for governed datasets, `drop` takes it off the waiting list, `used` says a new version took it.

from.description: The dataset the item is of.

at.description: When the line was written (UTC, ISO 8601).

capture.description: pick: the capture the dataset was made from.

for.description: pick: the datasets it may join.

by.description: Who picked or dropped it, as they said.

into.description: used: the dataset that took it.

actor.description: Who ran the command that wrote it (RFC-027).
